ayahs.textArabic: هَلْ اَتٰى عَلَى الْاِنْسَانِ حِيْنٌ مِّنَ الدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُنْ شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُوْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Hal atāka ‘alal-insāni ḥīnum minad-dahri lam yakun syai'am mażkūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: HAS THERE [not] been an endless span of time before man [appeared - a time] when he was not yet a thing to be thought of?

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا خَلَقْنَا الْاِنْسَانَ مِنْ نُّطْفَةٍ اَمْشَاجٍۖ نَّبْتَلِيْهِ فَجَعَلْنٰهُ سَمِيْعًاۢ بَصِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innā khalaqnal-insāna min nuṭfatin amsyājin nabtalīhi fa ja‘alnāhu samī‘am baṣīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, it is We who have created man out of a drop of sperm intermingled, so that We might try him [in his later life]: and therefore We made him a being endowed with hearing and sight.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا هَدَيْنٰهُ السَّبِيْلَ اِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَّاِمَّا كَفُوْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innā hadaināhus-sabīla immā syākiraw wa immā kafūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Verily, We have shown him the way: [and it rests with him to prove himself] either grateful or ungrateful.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّآ اَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكٰفِرِيْنَ سَلٰسِلَا۟ وَاَغْلٰلًا وَّسَعِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innā a‘tadnā lil-kāfirīna salāsila wa aglālaw wa sa‘īrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [Now,] behold, for those who deny the truth We have readied chains and shackles, and a blazing flame

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ الْاَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُوْنَ مِنْ كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُوْرًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Innal-abrāra yasyrabūna min ka'sin kāna mizājuhā kāfūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [whereas,] behold, the truly virtuous shall drink from a cup flavoured with the calyx of sweet-smelling flowers:

ayahs.textArabic: عَيْنًا يَّشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ اللّٰهِ يُفَجِّرُوْنَهَا تَفْجِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: ‘Ainay yasyrabu bihā ‘ibādullāhi yufajjirūnahā tafjīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: a source [of bliss] whereof God's servants shall drink, seeing it flow in a flow abundant.

ayahs.textArabic: يُوْفُوْنَ بِالنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُوْنَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهٗ مُسْتَطِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Yūfūna bin-nażri wa yakhāfūna yauman kāna syarruhū mustaṭīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [The truly virtuous are] they [who] fulfil their vows, and stand in awe of a Day the woe of which is bound to spread far and wide,

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُطْعِمُوْنَ الطَّعَامَ عَلٰى حُبِّهٖ مِسْكِيْنًا وَّيَتِيْمًا وَّاَسِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yuṭ‘imūnaṭ-ṭa‘āma ‘alā ḥubbihī miskīnaw wa yatīmaw wa asīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and who give food - however great be their own want of it - unto the needy, and the orphan, and the captive,

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ اللّٰهِ لَا نُرِيْدُ مِنْكُمْ جَزَاۤءً وَّلَا شُكُوْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innamā nuṭ‘imukum liwajhillāhi lā nurīdu minkum jazā'aw wa lā syukūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [saying, in their hearts,] "We feed you for the sake of God alone: we desire no recompense from you, nor thanks:

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا نَخَافُ مِنْ رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوْسًا قَمْطَرِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Innā nakhāfu mir rabbinā yauman ‘abūsan qamṭarīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: behold, we stand in awe of our Sustainer's judgment on a distressful, fateful Day!"

ayahs.textArabic: فَوَقٰىهُمُ اللّٰهُ شَرَّ ذٰلِكَ الْيَوْمِ وَلَقّٰىهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَّسُرُوْرًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Fa waqāhumullāhu syarra żālikal-yaumi wa laqqāhum naḍrataw wa surūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And so, God will preserve them from the woes of that Day, and will bestow on them brightness and joy,

ayahs.textArabic: وَجَزٰىهُمْ بِمَا صَبَرُوْا جَنَّةً وَّحَرِيْرًاۙ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa jazāhum bimā ṣabarū jannataw wa ḥarīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and will reward them for all their patience in adversity with a garden [of bliss] and with [garments of] silk.

ayahs.textArabic: مُّتَّكِـِٕيْنَ فِيْهَا عَلَى الْاَرَاۤىِٕكِۚ  لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيْهَا شَمْسًا وَّلَا زَمْهَرِيْرًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Muttaki'īna fīhā ‘alal-arā'ik(i), lā yarauna fīhā syamsaw wa lā zamharīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: In that [garden] they will on couches recline, and will know therein neither [burning] sun nor cold severe,

ayahs.textArabic: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوْفُهَا تَذْلِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa dāniyatan ‘alaihim ẓilāluhā wa żullilat quṭūfuhā tażlīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: since its [blissful] shades will come down low over them, and low will hang down its clusters of fruit, most easy to reach.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِمْ بِاٰنِيَةٍ مِّنْ فِضَّةٍ وَّاَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيْرَا۠
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yuṭāfu ‘alaihim bi'āniyatim min fiḍḍatiw wa akwābin kānat qawārīrā.
ayahs.textEnglish: And they will be waited upon with vessels of silver and goblets that will [seem to] be crystal –

ayahs.textArabic: قَوَارِيْرَا۟ مِنْ فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوْهَا تَقْدِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Qawārīra min fiḍḍatin qaddarūhā taqdīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: crystal-like, [but] of silver - the measure whereof they alone will determine.

ayahs.textArabic: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيْهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنْجَبِيْلًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yusqauna fīhā ka'san kāna mizājuhā zanjabīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And in that [paradise] they will be given to drink of a cup flavoured with ginger,

ayahs.textArabic: عَيْنًا فِيْهَا تُسَمّٰى سَلْسَبِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: ‘Ainan fīhā tusammā salsabīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [derived from] a source [to be found] therein, whose name is "Seek Thy Way".

ayahs.textArabic: ۞ وَيَطُوْفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَانٌ مُّخَلَّدُوْنَۚ اِذَا رَاَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنْثُوْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa yaṭūfu ‘alaihim wildānum mukhalladūn(a), iżā ra'aitahum ḥasibtahum lu'lu'am manṡūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: And immortal youths will wait upon them: when thou seest them, thou wouldst deem them to be scattered pearls;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاِذَا رَاَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَاَيْتَ نَعِيْمًا وَّمُلْكًا كَبِيْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa iżā ra'aita ṡamma ra'aita  na‘īmaw wa mulkan kabīrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and when thou seest [anything that is] there thou wilt see [only] bliss and a realm transcendent

ayahs.textArabic: عٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُنْدُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَّاِسْتَبْرَقٌۖ وَّحُلُّوْٓا اَسَاوِرَ مِنْ فِضَّةٍۚ وَسَقٰىهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُوْرًا
ayahs.textLatin: ‘Āliyahum ṡiyābu sundusin khuḍruw wa istabraq(un), wa ḥullū asāwira  min fiḍḍah(tin), wa saqāhum rabbuhum syarāban ṭahūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Upon those [blest] will be garments of green silk and brocade; and they will be adorned with bracelets of silver. And their Sustainer will them to drink of a drink most pure.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَاۤءً وَّكَانَ سَعْيُكُمْ مَّشْكُوْرًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hāżā kāna lakum jazā'aw wa kāna sa‘yukum masykūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [And they will be told:] "Verily, all this is your reward since Your endeavour [in life] has met [God's] goodly acceptance!"

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ الْقُرْاٰنَ تَنْزِيْلًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Innā naḥnu nazzalnā ‘alaikal-qur'āna tanzīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, [O believer,] it is We who have bestowed from on high this Qur’an upon thee, step by step - truly a bestowal from on high!

ayahs.textArabic: فَاصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ اٰثِمًا اَوْ كَفُوْرًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Faṣbir liḥukmi rabbika wa lā tuṭi‘ minhum āṡiman au kafūrā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: Await, then, in all patience thy Sustainer's judgment, and pay no heed to any of them, who is a wilful sinner or an ingrate;

ayahs.textArabic: وَاذْكُرِ اسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَّاَصِيْلًاۚ
ayahs.textLatin: Ważkurisma rabbika bukrataw wa aṣīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and bear in mind thy Sustainer's name at morn and evening

ayahs.textArabic: وَمِنَ الَّيْلِ فَاسْجُدْ لَهٗ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Wa minal-laili fasjud lahū wa sabbiḥhu lailan ṭawīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: and during some of the night, and prostrate thyself before Him, and extol His limitless glory throughout the long night.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰٓؤُلَاۤءِ يُحِبُّوْنَ الْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُوْنَ وَرَاۤءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hā'ulā'i yuḥibbūnal-‘ājilata wa yażarūna warā'ahum yauman ṡaqīlā(n)
ayahs.textEnglish: Behold, they [who are unmindful of God] love this fleeting life, and leave behind them [all thought of] a grief-laden Day.

ayahs.textArabic: نَحْنُ خَلَقْنٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ اَسْرَهُمْۚ وَاِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ اَمْثَالَهُمْ تَبْدِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Naḥnu khalaqnāhum wa syadadnā asrahum, wa iżā syi'nā baddalnā amṡālahum tabdīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: [They will not admit to themselves that] it We who have created them and strengthened their make - and [that] if it be Our will We can replace them entirely with others of their kind.

ayahs.textArabic: اِنَّ هٰذِهٖ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۚ فَمَنْ شَاۤءَ اتَّخَذَ اِلٰى رَبِّهٖ سَبِيْلًا
ayahs.textLatin: Inna hāżihī tażkirah(tun), faman syā'attakhaża ilā rabbihī sabīlā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: VERILY, all this is an admonition: whoever, then, so wills, may unto his Sustainer find a way.

ayahs.textArabic: وَمَا تَشَاۤءُوْنَ اِلَّآ اَنْ يَّشَاۤءَ اللّٰهُ ۗاِنَّ اللّٰهَ كَانَ عَلِيْمًا حَكِيْمًاۖ
ayahs.textLatin: Wa mā tasyā'ūna illā ay yasyā'allāh(u), innallāha kāna ‘alīman ḥakīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: But you cannot will it unless God wills [to show you that way]: for, behold, God is indeed all-seeing, wise.

ayahs.textArabic: يُّدْخِلُ مَنْ يَّشَاۤءُ فِيْ رَحْمَتِهٖۗ وَالظّٰلِمِيْنَ اَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا اَلِيْمًا ࣖ
ayahs.textLatin: Yudkhilu may yasyā'u fī raḥmatih(ī),  waẓ-ẓālimīna a‘adda lahum ‘ażāban alīmā(n).
ayahs.textEnglish: He admits unto His grace everyone who wills [to be admitted]; but as for the evildoers - for them has He readied grievous suffering [in the life to come].
